scope: Staging-only source research; no database edits

records_reviewed.title: ANU Masters International Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic A$30k fully-funded claim not supported as one named scholarship; ANU University Research Scholarship is a stipend award (A$40,475 in 2027) for research degrees; tuition support is separate; Round 1 international closed 31 Aug 2026; Round 2 15 Apr 2027.

records_reviewed.title: ANU PhD International Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic full tuition plus A$30k is not a verified named award; ANU University Research Scholarship pays A$40,475 annual 2027 stipend, PhD 3.5 years; international 2027 Round 1 closed 31 Aug 2026; 15 Apr 2027 is Round 2, not a universal deadline.

records_reviewed.title: Melbourne Research Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Existing named award is real; official page states A$39,500 stipend 2026 and automatic consideration. Distinguish fee offset only from stipend-plus-fee awards. Do not replace 2026 MRS stipend with separate RTP 2027 A$41,100 figure without matching source.

records_reviewed.title: University of Melbourne Masters Excellence Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic full tuition + A$28k unsupported; reconcile with named Melbourne Research Scholarship and RTP; both only for research masters, not all coursework masters; 2027 RTP stipend A$41,100 not generic award.

records_reviewed.title: University of Melbourne Phd International Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic full tuition + A$28k unsupported as independently named scheme; reconcile with Melbourne Research Scholarship and RTP; competitive stipend, no universal automatic living allowance.

records_reviewed.title: University of Queensland Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic full tuition + A$30k requires identity review; official UQGRSS/RTP 2026 stipend A$39,220, indexed; PhD/MPhil/research doctorate only, domestic/international, nomination and supervisor supported EOI. International round closing 22 Mar 2027 on official schedule.

records_reviewed.title: University of Sydney Masters Excellence Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic title not independently verified; official international RTP/USYDIS only for higher degree by research, not all masters. 2027 stipend A$44,293, RTP fee offset covers 100% tuition and OSHC, 2027 periods 3/4 deadline 18 Dec 2026.

records_reviewed.title: University of Sydney Phd International Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic title needs named-programme reconciliation with RTP/USYDIS; stipend A$44,293 2027, paired fee offset 100% up to 14 research periods; deadlines differ by research period: 11 Sep 2026 (early) and 18 Dec 2026 (later).

records_reviewed.title: UNSW Scientia Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Do NOT archive as discontinued: UNSW published a new Scientia PhD project on 8 Oct 2026 explicitly under Scientia PhD Scholarship Scheme. That project is domestic-only and offers A$39,991 2027 annual stipend plus A$25k one-off mobility grant. Generic A$50k/A$10k figures not applicable to that project; scheme-wide eligibility and deadline require verification.

records_reviewed.title: NUS Masters Excellence Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic named award not confirmed. NUS Research Scholarship supports research masters (faculty-specific admission, some faculty masters scholarships restricted to Singapore citizens/PR); international research masters stipend S$2,900/month from 1 Jan 2026, full tuition waiver, not all taught masters.

records_reviewed.title: NUS Phd International Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic title may overlap named NUS Research Scholarship; full tuition plus S$3,000/month international PhD from Jan 2026; S$500/month possible after PhD QE; faculty deadlines and Graduate Assistantship requirements apply.

records_reviewed.title: NUS Undergraduate Excellence Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Generic title must be matched to a named NUS scholarship. NUS International Undergraduate Scholarship already exists as a PRIVATE draft; 100% subsidised tuition only after MOE Tuition Grant, S$5,800 annual living, S$5,000 accommodation, S$1,750 one-time computer; 3-year Tuition Grant service bond applies.

records_reviewed.title: NUS ASEAN Undergraduate Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Named programme verified; existing listed subsidised tuition and allowances match official. IMPORTANT mandatory MOE Tuition Grant normally carries 3-year Singapore work bond; medicine/dentistry have distinct bonds. No separate scholarship application; do not assign universal IELTS/TOEFL/SAT or guessed deadline.

records_reviewed.title: NUS Research Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Named scholarship and existing 2026 stipend details align official page: S$3,000 international PhD, S$2,900 international research Masters; tuition waiver; additional S$500 possible post-QE. Graduate Assistantship requirement and faculty-specific admissions. Review for authenticated provenance, do not blindly mark verified.

records_reviewed.title: Yale-NUS Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Confirmed obsolete for new applicants: Yale-NUS stopped admitting new cohorts after Class of 2025 and college closed 30 June 2025. Needs authorized audited archive; do not relabel as NUS College scholarship.

records_reviewed.title: Taiwan ICDF Scholarship
records_reviewed.finding: Same TaiwanICDF International Higher Education Scholarship Program as other published ICDF record; official 2027 applications 1 Dec 2026–15 Mar 2027; eligible beneficiary countries only; Bachelor limited to diplomatic allies; institution-specific language requirements, no universal TaiwanICDF IELTS/TOEFL minimum. Do not duplicate.

records_reviewed.title: Taiwan Scholarship (ICDF)
records_reviewed.finding: Duplicate candidate of Taiwan ICDF Scholarship, not the separate MOE Taiwan Scholarship; official 2027 window 1 Dec 2026–15 Mar 2027. Eligible beneficiary countries only; only designated partner programmes, Bachelor diplomatic allies only. Archive only via authenticated audited duplicate resolution.
